AMENDED 2026-09-04 (second run, `run screen hormuz-maritime` re-run authorized by Ron): the first run this same day wrote zero rows because the one placement that cleared both the mechanical VERIFIED-evidence bar and profile completeness (WORLD-KINECT/bunker-and-voyage-services) was also the exact placement the concurrent fresh-context census audit (atlas-fresh-context, 2026-09-04T03:53:11Z, status FAIL, 20 amendments_required, mapping still ACTIVE) flagged as evidentially unsound. Since then, profile batches 4 and 5 closed 13 more issuers to COMPLETE O2: INTERNATIONAL-SEAWAYS, OKEANIS-ECO-TANKERS, SFL-CORP, TSAKOS-ENERGY-NAVIGATION, CMB-TECH, DHT-HOLDINGS, FRONTLINE, NORDIC-AMERICAN-TANKERS, TEEKAY-TANKERS, PERFORMANCE-SHIPPING (crude-tanker-tonnage) and HUNTINGTON-INGALLS, ELBIT-SYSTEMS, EXAIL-TECHNOLOGIES (naval-escort-and-mine-clearance). This run also picked up the screen gate's foreign-listing fix (commit 73814c4): market_ticker now compares against the mapped listing's market_ticker rather than its bare ticker, which matters for EXAIL-TECHNOLOGIES (EPA-EXA, market_ticker EXA.PA). Every row still rests on Ron's 2026-09-01 PLACEMENT-scope rule: audit_scope 'PLACEMENT' declared on the row, admitted only when the consumed placement's role evidence is entirely VERIFIED (never INFERRED) AND the placement is not among the audit's 20 named amendments_required, even where the JSON tag still literally reads VERIFIED (an audit writes only audit/status/changelog, never placement content, per method section 6A, so a flagged placement's tag is not retroactively corrected). Per-link account, worked money-corner first, then the three CHOKE_POINT links, then the rest by chain position:

specialty-marine-broking [MONEY CORNER]: searched and empty, unchanged. 4 ACTIVE placements (AON, ARTHUR-J-GALLAGHER, MARSH-MCLENNAN, WILLIS-TOWERS-WATSON) all carry INFERRED role evidence; WILLIS-TOWERS-WATSON is additionally audit-flagged for citing one named individual broker as if the whole organization prices the Gulf war-risk market. All 4 issuers now carry COMPLETE O2 profiles -- profiling did not unblock this link, because the mapping's evidence tagging is the actual gap. Needs re-evidenced VERIFIED-tag role claims (Atlas) or a passing census audit, not more profile work.

hormuz-transit-control [CHOKE_POINT]: searched and empty, unchanged. Zero mapped placements: the census closed this link EXHAUSTED, no qualifying public issuer (named authorities are sanctioned or state per the chain's own bottleneck note).

crew-and-warlike-area-manning [CHOKE_POINT]: searched and empty, unchanged. Zero mapped placements: EXHAUSTED, named ship managers and manning agencies are private.

crude-tanker-tonnage [CHOKE_POINT]: 7 ROWS WRITTEN (FRONTLINE, DHT-HOLDINGS, INTERNATIONAL-SEAWAYS, TEEKAY-TANKERS, NORDIC-AMERICAN-TANKERS, TSAKOS-ENERGY-NAVIGATION, SFL-CORP), all bucketed pure_play. Of the 10 mapped placements, these 7 carry all-VERIFIED role evidence, are not audit-flagged, and now have COMPLETE O2 profiles referencing this exact chain/link. The other 3 (OKEANIS-ECO-TANKERS, CMB-TECH, PERFORMANCE-SHIPPING) are also COMPLETE O2 profiled but their mapping placement role evidence is INFERRED, not VERIFIED, so the mechanical PLACEMENT-scope bar still refuses them -- re-evidencing those 3 placements, not more profiling, is what would seat them next.

war-risk-reinsurance-capacity: searched and empty, unchanged. 10 ACTIVE placements, all INFERRED role evidence; none profiled.

marine-war-risk-underwriting: searched and empty. 3 placements admissible on VERIFIED evidence (AXIS-CAPITAL, W-R-BERKLEY, LANCASHIRE-HOLDINGS), none profiled yet -- admissible-but-unprofiled.

maritime-risk-and-protection: searched and empty, unchanged. The link's only placement (SPIRE-GLOBAL) is status REJECTED, not ACTIVE, so it is not a qualified placement regardless of its own COMPLETE O2 profile elsewhere in the repo. This is the chain's own documented finding: one honest ticker, and it does not qualify.

naval-escort-and-mine-clearance: 3 ROWS WRITTEN (HUNTINGTON-INGALLS, ELBIT-SYSTEMS, EXAIL-TECHNOLOGIES), bucketed second_order (government-procurement counter-response, not the direct shipping/energy value chain). Of 10 mapped placements, 8 clear the VERIFIED-evidence bar (HUNTINGTON-INGALLS, TEXTRON, ELBIT-SYSTEMS, LEONARDO-DRS, RTX, KONGSBERG-GRUPPEN, BAE-SYSTEMS, EXAIL-TECHNOLOGIES). GENERAL-DYNAMICS carries INFERRED evidence and is separately audit-flagged for overstating actual Knifefish deployment ('could potentially be employed' in the source vs. 'being used' in the mapping's role text) -- it stays excluded even though it now has a COMPLETE O2 profile. Of the 8 admissible, 3 (HUNTINGTON-INGALLS, ELBIT-SYSTEMS, EXAIL-TECHNOLOGIES) are COMPLETE O2 and referenced -> rows written. TEXTRON, LEONARDO-DRS, RTX are admissible-but-unprofiled, the deepest remaining pool on this link. KONGSBERG-GRUPPEN and BAE-SYSTEMS are admissible but their own profiles are BLOCKED/O3 -- their own data gaps, not this link's.

bunker-and-voyage-services: searched and empty, but the picture changed: all 6 mapped placements (WORLD-KINECT, BP, CHEVRON, SINOPEC-CORP, PETROCHINA, CBL-INTERNATIONAL) are now COMPLETE O2 profiled, and still zero are admissible. WORLD-KINECT carries VERIFIED evidence but is the audit's named defect (4-day source_date mismatch, excerpt confirms identity only, not the marine-bunker role claim). SINOPEC-CORP, PETROCHINA and CBL-INTERNATIONAL are INFERRED and separately audit-flagged (overstated or date-mismatched claims). BP and CHEVRON are simply INFERRED, never flagged, just under the mechanical bar. This link is now fully profiled and fully blocked on evidence quality alone -- further profiling here would not help; re-evidencing would.

lng-shipping-and-qatari-supply: searched and empty. 3 placements admissible on VERIFIED evidence (FLEX-LNG, GOLAR-LNG, EXCELERATE-ENERGY), none profiled -- admissible-but-unprofiled.

container-liner-diversion: searched and empty. 3 placements (EVERGREEN-MARINE, YANG-MING, WAN-HAI-LINES) carry VERIFIED evidence but all 3 are audit-flagged (generic, undated TWSE company-profile pages with zero mention of Hormuz, diversion or surcharges); the remaining 4 (ZIM-INTEGRATED-SHIPPING, COSCO-SHIPPING-HOLDINGS, ORIENT-OVERSEAS-INTERNATIONAL, HAPAG-LLOYD) are INFERRED. Zero admissible, none profiled.

hormuz-bypass-pipelines: searched and empty, unchanged. 2 placements (KONINKLIJKE-VOPAK, SINOPEC-KANTONS-HOLDINGS), both INFERRED and both audit-flagged (cited source never names either company). Both carry BLOCKED/O3 profiles regardless.

non-gulf-energy-substitution: searched and empty. 7 placements admissible on VERIFIED evidence (VENTURE-GLOBAL, CHENIERE-ENERGY, NEXTDECADE, EXXONMOBIL, PETROBRAS, EQUINOR, WOODSIDE-ENERGY), none profiled -- the single deepest untouched admissible pool on this chain. CHEVRON now carries a COMPLETE O2 profile but its placement evidence here is INFERRED, so it stays inadmissible.

cargo-owners-and-energy-importers: searched and empty. FORMOSA-PETROCHEMICAL carries VERIFIED evidence but is audit-flagged (TWSE live snapshot page has no fixed publish date, so the recorded source_date cannot be trusted). PBF-ENERGY is VERIFIED and not flagged -- admissible-but-unprofiled, the one open name on this link. SINOPEC-CORP now carries a COMPLETE O2 profile but its evidence here is INFERRED.

Net effect: 10 rows written across 2 of 14 links (crude-tanker-tonnage, naval-escort-and-mine-clearance), both now producing their full admissible-and-profiled set. The money corner and the other two CHOKE_POINT links remain exactly as documented: thin or empty of listed expression by mapping design (hormuz-transit-control, crew-and-warlike-area-manning), or blocked purely on evidence quality rather than profiling coverage (specialty-marine-broking, now fully profiled and fully inadmissible). Highest-value next steps, in order: (1) Atlas re-evidences the 3 crude-tanker-tonnage INFERRED placements (OKEANIS-ECO-TANKERS, CMB-TECH, PERFORMANCE-SHIPPING) and the specialty-marine-broking money-corner placements, both already fully profiled and blocked only on tagging; (2) `run profile --campaign` next prioritizes non-gulf-energy-substitution (7 admissible VERIFIED names, zero profiled) and the remaining naval-escort-and-mine-clearance names (TEXTRON, LEONARDO-DRS, RTX).
